about: Sales tax rates by US ZIP code, from each state's published rates. A suggestion for the store to confirm: rates can differ within a ZIP code, and local restaurant taxes are noted, not always included. Check with the store's accountant.

notes: No state sales tax; many boroughs and cities have their own (in the rate), and some add alcohol or bed taxes.
AK.source: Alaska Remote Seller Sales Tax Commission rate sheet, October 1, 2026

AL.source: Alabama DOR, local tax rates file (current)

notes: Many cities add an advertising and promotion (hotel and restaurant) tax on prepared food, usually 1 to 3%.
Mixed drinks served: a 4% mixed drink tax and a 10% supplemental tax.
AR.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Arizona cities tax restaurants and bars at their own rate (the rate here is for restaurants where the city publishes one).
AZ.source: Arizona DOR, TPT rates for restaurants and bars, October 2026

notes: Home-rule cities collect their own sales tax: register with the city as well.
CO.source: Colorado DOR, jurisdiction codes and rates July to December 2026

CT.source: CT DRS PS 2019(5): meals 7.35% since October 1, 2019

DC.source: DC OTR: general 6% through September 30, 2027 (the increase to 7% postponed); restaurant meals and drinks 10%

notes: Miami-Dade County: a food and beverage tax (up to 2%) at restaurants licensed to serve alcohol.
FL.source: Florida DOR DR-15DSS, Discretionary Sales Surtax Information for Calendar Year 2026 (https://floridarevenue.com/Forms_library/current/dr15dss_26.pdf)

GA.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: The general excise tax is on the business; it may be passed on to guests at up to 4.712% (with the county's 0.5%).
HI.source: Hawaii Department of Taxation: general excise tax 4% plus a 0.5% county surcharge in Honolulu, Hawaii, Kauai and Maui counties

IA.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Resort cities (Ketchum, Sun Valley, McCall and others) add a local option tax, up to 3%.
ID.lookUp: https://tax.idaho.gov/ (resort city taxes: Ketchum, Sun Valley, McCall and others)

notes: Chicago adds a 0.5% restaurant tax, and 1% more in the Metropolitan Pier and Exposition area; other cities have their own.
Many counties and cities add a food and beverage tax, usually 1 to 2%.
IN.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

KS.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Some cities add a restaurant tax, up to 3%.
KY.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

LA.lookUp: https://lulstb.com/ (Louisiana Uniform Local Sales Tax Board rate lookup)

notes: Most cities and towns (Boston among them) add a 0.75% local meals tax: 7% in all.

MD.source: Comptroller of Maryland: alcoholic beverages 9% since July 1, 2011

ME.source: Maine Revenue Services: prepared food and liquor served 8%

MI.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Minneapolis and some other cities add a food and beverage tax (downtown Minneapolis 3%).
MN.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

MO.source: Missouri DOR, rate tables October to December 2026

notes: Many cities add a tourism tax on restaurants, usually 1 to 3%.
MS.source: Mississippi DOR: 7% state; Jackson adds a 1% special sales tax

notes: Resort towns (Whitefish, Big Sky, West Yellowstone and others) add a resort tax, up to 4%.
MT.lookUp: https://mtrevenue.gov/ (resort area taxes: Whitefish, Big Sky, West Yellowstone and others)

notes: Some counties add a 1% prepared food and beverage tax (Mecklenburg, Wake, Durham, Dare and others).
NC.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Some cities add a restaurant and lodging tax (Bismarck, Fargo and others).
ND.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Some cities add an occupation tax on restaurants (Omaha 2.5%).
NE.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

NH.source: NH meals and rooms tax 8.5% since October 1, 2021 (a 2026 bill to raise it failed)

notes: Urban Enterprise Zones may charge half the rate; Atlantic City adds a luxury tax on drinks.
NJ.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Gross receipts tax: on the business, usually passed on to guests.
NM.source: New Mexico TRD, gross receipts tax rates July 2026 to June 2027

NV.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

OH.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

OK.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Ashland adds a 5% food and beverage tax.
Allegheny County adds a 7% drink tax on poured drinks; Philadelphia a 10% liquor tax on drinks.
PA.source: PA Department of Revenue: 6% state; Allegheny County 1% and Philadelphia 2% local sales tax

RI.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Many cities and counties add a local hospitality tax on prepared food, up to 2%.
SC.source: SC DOR sales and use tax rates by county, 5/1/26 and after (https://dor.sc.gov/sales-and-use)

notes: Many cities add a municipal gross receipts tax on restaurants, up to 1%. The state rate goes back to 4.5% on July 1, 2027.
SD.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

TN.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

TX.source: Texas Comptroller, local rate file for the quarter

notes: Most counties add a 1% restaurant tax.
UT.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Most counties and cities add a local meals tax, usually 4 to 7.5%.
VA.source: Virginia Tax, sales tax rates by locality, January 2026 to now

notes: Some towns add a 1% local option meals and alcohol tax.
VT.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Spirits served are taxed by the liter as well.
WA.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

notes: Some cities add a food and beverage tax; premier resort areas a resort tax.
WI.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

WV.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter

WY.source: Streamlined Sales Tax rate and boundary files for the quarter
